CfxProperties.Name: auto-on
CfxProperties.Description:
Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms.
A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected.
Example setting: 5000,10

CfxProperties.Name: auto-off
CfxProperties.Description:
Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms.
A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected.
Example setting: 8000,5

CfxProperties.Name: auto-shutoff
CfxProperties.Description:
Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms.
A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected.
Example setting: 120000

CfxProperties.Name: auto-dim
CfxProperties.Description:
Base delay in ms followed by a % of randomness. 5000,10 <=> {4500 ; 5500} ms.
A new random color profile is selected at each ignition. Every 10 ignition a random blade profile is selected.
Example setting: 360000,30

CfxProperties.Name: tangible
CfxProperties.Description:
Tangible font selection. Use with an external 10k Pullup resistor to 3.3V (main or aux.) and GPIO1 - Now 16 slots.
x <-> don't start / X <-> don't start + retraction on removal / o <-> start ok / - <-> neutral / number <-> font to change to addons : r <-> detects removal but won't prevent start / O <-> plays start ok only if previously in another state.
Example setting: o,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,-,X

CfxProperties.Name: oledflip
CfxProperties.Description: rotates the display 180� to adapt to the wiring or orientation in the hilt. 0 (or commented) is the regular orientation with the text being read normally with the screen wiring pads on the left side. 1 flips the orientation 180�.

CfxProperties.Name: oledversion
CfxProperties.Description: defines if the firmware version is displayed at boot time (before the boot logo) and for how long (in ms).

CfxProperties.Name: oledscreensaver
CfxProperties.Description: delay after which the screen savers will be triggered on the OLED.

CfxProperties.Name: oledcustom
CfxProperties.Description: custom text to display on the OLED along with the firmware version screen (boot time if oledversion is enabled, and idle time). About 20 characters maximum.

CfxProperties.Name: oledstop
CfxProperties.Description: disables the oled from further use (for testing purpose). When this parameter is present the OLED is disabled

CfxProperties.Name: bladecharge
CfxProperties.FriendlyName: Enables power drivers L1- to L4- to enable charging the battery without addon board
CfxProperties.Description: enable any of the power drivers (L1- to L4-) that are used by strip power so that the blade charge can go thru the board and charge the battery without any add-on board. If live wire option is used, browsing the OLED or accessing blade PLI will revive the drivers and will allow for charging too even if live wire prevents the powering of the drivers in other conditions
